## Work (case studies for businesses)
- [Work](https://jadedviber.com/work/): systems built for real businesses in conversation with an LLM — pipeline, blog-from-a-Doc, compliance portal, rep order portal, LLM cost gate, piGate.
- [Photos to product pages](https://jadedviber.com/work/photo-to-web.html): a 15-minute unattended pipeline from a Drive folder to Odoo, a Google Sheet, a customer photo folder, and WooCommerce product pages.
- [A blog you write from one Google Doc](https://jadedviber.com/work/blog-from-a-doc.html): Point 4 case study — one Google Doc with a Publish menu, an n8n workflow that round-trips the Doc with Webflow CMS (create/update keyed on a Post ID, slug frozen at first publish), and a Drive photo pool that rotates cover photos. Beehiiv runs the signup forms and newsletter alongside; feeding the newsletter from the blog is the designed next step.
- [An order portal for 1099 sales reps](https://jadedviber.com/work/rep-order-portal.html): Dax Distro case study — a sign-in order portal for independent reps with a Google Sheet as the database. Rep-scoped customers, line items from live stock, a volume-tier pricing and commission engine (tier from the whole order's weight, overrides logged, server recomputes), order status workflow, admin inventory with an audit ledger, two-way stock sync with WooCommerce, customers and items to QuickBooks, product pages created from a Drive photo with an n8n-written description. Built on Google Apps Script in a day, rewritten in PHP (Slim 4) six weeks later. Retired with the company, July 2026.
- [Lead tracking on the reps' phones](https://jadedviber.com/work/rep-leads-app.html): Dax Distro case study — an AppSheet app over one Google Sheet. Row-level visibility from a rep roster tab, one-tap Call/Email/Text that logs an activity row then opens the dialer, per-lead notes, status that advances on first contact, a map, a per-rep activity chart; the office pushes new leads from a staging tab with an Apps Script menu that emails each rep. Preceded by a Python Gmail parser that synced per-rep sheets. Retired with the company, July 2026.
- [A compliance portal that keeps the batch trail](https://jadedviber.com/work/compliance-portal.html): TCT case study — a multi-company Laravel portal for Texas DSHS Chapter 300 hemp compliance. Ingredient registry with lab reports → master recipe (printed for two signatures) → individual batch (actual weights, ingredient COAs pinned; blocked without a COA) → production run (lot numbers, sales orders) → public pre-sale COA page for the label. Google sign-in, roles, append-only audit log. Recall plans and audit reports are the next phases, not built yet.

## Projects
- [PhotoEditor](https://jadedviber.com/projects/photo-editor.html): macOS Tkinter app for bulk product-photo processing — scene-aware subject cut (SAM + BiRefNet), rembg fallback, smart 1000×1000 crop, SKU banner stamping.

## App & legal
- [JadedViber app](https://jadedviber.com/app/): personal Google Workspace automation tools (MCP servers + n8n) that act on your own Google account at your request.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jadedviber.com/privacy/): how the tools handle data, incl. Google API limited-use disclosure.
- [Terms of Service](https://jadedviber.com/terms/): terms governing use of the tools.
